title: Boss: drop Newtonsoft.Json
summary: A real migration ticket: rewrite attributes, calls and usings from Newtonsoft.Json to System.Text.Json with find-and-replace, then script it and count what is left for a human.

steps.title: PLAT-482
body: > **PLAT-482: Orders.Api: replace Newtonsoft.Json with System.Text.Json.** Mechanical changes only in this PR;
> anything that needs thought is listed for review.
The service has 140 files. Most of the change is mechanical, which makes it a find-and-replace job:
4. Script all of it, make it safe to run twice, and count the lines a human must still look at.
Anything without a one-to-one replacement (`JObject`, `Required = ...`) must be left untouched, not guessed at.

steps.title: Rewrite the attributes
prompt: Turn `[JsonProperty("order_id")]` into `[JsonPropertyName("order_id")]`, keeping the name. Attributes with
other arguments, such as `[JsonProperty(Required = Required.Always)]` or `[JsonProperty("a", Order = 2)]`,
have no direct equivalent: leave them for review.

steps.title: Rewrite the calls
prompt: Rewrite both calls with **one** pattern and **one** replacement:

steps.title: Rewrite the usings
prompt: In a whole file, change `using Newtonsoft.Json;` to `using System.Text.Json;` and
`using Newtonsoft.Json.Serialization;` to `using System.Text.Json.Serialization;`, with one pattern and one
replacement. `using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;` stays: `JObject` code needs a human.

steps.title: Script the migration
prompt: Put it together so it can run over all 140 files.
- `string Migrate(string source)` applies the three rewrites (usings, attributes, calls) to a whole file.
Lines end with `\n`. Running it on its own output must change nothing.
- `int LeftForReview(string code)` counts the **lines** that still contain `Newtonsoft`, `JsonProperty(`
or the word `JObject`: the list for the human reviewer. (`JsonPropertyName(` does not count.)
For the sample file in the tests, `LeftForReview(Migrate(file))` is 3: the `Linq` using, the `Required`
attribute and the `JObject.Parse` line. `System.Text.RegularExpressions` is already imported.
template: Dojo.Eq("the sample file is migrated", dojoWant, dojoOut);
Dojo.Eq("running it twice changes nothing", dojoOut, Migrate(dojoOut));
Dojo.Eq("Serialization using is migrated too", "using System.Text.Json.Serialization;\nusing System;", Migrate("using Newtonsoft.Json.Serialization;\nusing System;"));
Dojo.Eq("3 lines left for review", 3, LeftForReview(dojoOut));
Dojo.Eq("a clean file needs no review", 0, LeftForReview("using System.Text.Json;\n[JsonPropertyName(\"id\")]"));
Dojo.Eq("two mentions on one line count once", 1, LeftForReview("var t = JObject.Parse(Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.SerializeObject(x));"));
